decisions.decision: The Chapter 61B conversion item is placed on the January 8, 2019 agenda, where the Board is expected to take an official vote not to exercise its first right of refusal.
decisions.quote: this item will be placed on the january 8, 2019 agenda.

decisions.decision: Mr. Toale wants interim uses for the TC Passios, Brooks, old Primary, Town Hall and Ritter Memorial buildings reported in upcoming Town Manager reports, and at least one warrant article is to be prepared for Annual Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: mr. toale stated he would like to hear interim uses for these properties in upcoming town manager reports.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will seek feedback from town employees on the TC Passios, Brooks, old Primary, Town Hall and Ritter buildings while preparing warrant articles.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux would also like to hear feedback from town employees as they are the ones who work in these buildings.

decisions.decision: A Board workshop on January 15 with the Historical Commission, Historical Society and Architectural Preservation District Commission was noted as already planned.
decisions.quote: the board already has a workshop planned on january 15th with the historical commission, historical society and the architectural preservation district commission being invited

decisions.decision: Finance Committee budget meetings will include 'snow dates' on the Monday after the regular Thursday budget meetings if a Thursday meeting is cancelled; the schedule is to be circulated to departments.
decisions.quote: they agreed they would add "snow dates" on the monday after their regularly scheduled thursday budget meetings in the event the thursday meeting has to be cancelled.

decisions.decision: Meeting schedule set: next meeting January 8; January 15 workshop; meeting on January 22; January 29 reserved for a possible extra meeting.
decisions.quote: we will meet on the 22nd and are reserving the 29t in case of a needed extra meeting.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will reach out to the one known party that expressed interest in renting TC Passios space to learn why no bid was submitted.
decisions.quote: the school facilities director will be reaching out to the one known party that had expressed interest to learn why they did not submit a bid

budget_items.topic: Boys & Girls Club raffle prize (public comment)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A community raffle grand prize of $2500.00 was announced by a resident; it is not a town expenditure.
budget_items.quote: if you are number 172, you have won $2500.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water District stated it charges $2.00 a yard for the removed fill material sold to local contractors.
Fees listed in the 2019 annual license renewal table, including the Donnelly's Tavern and Whalom Gas entries (some amounts garbled in the OCR).
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux presented the remainder of the licenses up for renewal for 2019.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monty Tech will do the project this year; the Town avoids labor costs that would have been subject to prevailing wage rates, saving a significant amount of money (no figure given).
budget_items.quote: this will save the town a significant amount of money

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW Director received a quote of about $9,000 to replace the Ritter Building shutters; Ms. Adams asked the board to consider that cost.
budget_items.quote: the dpw director received a quote of approximately $9,000 to replace the shutters at the ritter building with new painted wooden

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Previously appropriated capital article funds would be available for repurposing once the State machine arrives.
budget_items.quote: totaling $25,000 would be available for repurposing.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engine #4 is out of service and needs about $15,000 in repairs; its replacement was a 2016 capital request for FY20 with an estimated cost of $685,000.
budget_items.quote: currently engine #4 is out of commission and will need approximately $15,000 in repairs to be functional.

budget_items.topic: Finance Department tax rate submission and budget figures
budget_items.what_was_recorded: No dollar figure printed; Finance Director updating budget figures for target budgets.
budget_items.quote: she is also working on updating the budget figures from the town meetings in budget documents and the financial forecast

budget_items.topic: Chapter 61B land conversion purchase option and back taxes
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town may purchase converted land at full and fair market value set by an appraiser hired at Town expense; Ms. Luck proposed a special fund for back taxes paid on conversion to pay for future appraisals and purchases.
budget_items.quote: in the case of an intended conversion of property, not involving a sale, the town shall have an option to purchase the land at full and fair market value

budget_items.topic: Open Space and Recreation Plan grant reimbursement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: State grant reimbursement rate for open space projects is around 62-64%.
budget_items.quote: the grant reimbursement rate from the state is around 62-64%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Luck found no increase in license fees since 1995 and said the Town does not look enough at revenue sources; Ms. Adams had suggested slight annual increases.
budget_items.quote: she went back to 1995 and could not find any other time when those fees have been raised since.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board approved an accounts payable warrant in the stated amount.
budget_items.quote: the board approved an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $198,213.82.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Casella's cost for recycled materials is $55/ton; the Town countered from $0/ton to $25/ton; Casella said that was not possible; the current single-stream market rate is $60-$70 per ton.
budget_items.quote: the town has countered by going from paying $0/ton to $25/ton.

budget_items.topic: Casella recycling contract General Fund impact
budget_items.what_was_recorded: If the Town started paying for recycling on July 1, 2019, the total impact to the General Fund would be $58,930, per the Finance Director's spreadsheet.
budget_items.quote: the total impact to the general fund would be $58,930.

budget_items.topic: Pay As You Throw bag price
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The PAYT trash bag price will rise because bag costs and the Casella contract terms increase each year, possibly up to 3%.
budget_items.quote: the terms of our contract increasing every year, which could be up to 3%.
